[P2] Search through successful map and parallel containers

When a child context awaits a map or parallel operation and calls `result.throwIfError()`, its direct child is the batch container, which checkpoints successfully with a `BatchResult` even when an item failed. That container has no `error`, so this filter never reaches the failed descendant. The enclosing context and execution report `ChildContextError` instead of the user's error, even live with the complete operation tree. Traverse through batch containers to failed descendants, preserving cycle/depth safeguards, and add coverage for this nesting.
